description: Soft-delete ONE version of a test case (`kind:"tc"`) or a reusable function (`kind:"fn"`) in the connected product. `versionId` comes from the parent's `versions[]` (populated by `tc_get` for TCs and `get_function` for FNs); pass the version's `name` too (backend validator requires it). TWO-STEP CONFIRM: call once with `confirm:false` (default) to get a DRY RUN — the response lists every entity still referencing this version (defects, suites, exec plans, scenarios, schedulers, pipelines, workflows for a TC; TCs, other FNs, workflows for a FN). Only when EVERY dependency map is empty is the delete allowed; the server itself REFUSES a `confirm:true` call when refs still exist, so `confirm:true` doesn't guarantee deletion — the tool inspects the response and reports honestly. Refuses to delete the LAST remaining version (the parent would be orphaned; use `tc_delete` / `delete_function` instead to remove the whole entity). SimplifyQA-only. Requires a live connection.

confirm.description: False (default) → dry-run; true → apply delete (server still refuses if any dependency exists).

kind.description: 'tc' for a test-case version; 'fn' for a function version.

parentId.description: Parent TC or FN id (numeric or business key like TC_123 / FN_45).

versionId.description: The version's uuid (from tc_get.versions[].id or get_function.versions[].id).

versionName.description: The version's human name (e.g. 'v1.0'). Required by the backend validator.

name: delete_version
title: Delete a version of a test case or function (two-step confirm)
